workers_accepted: All {count} workers were accepted. Their leader has stopped. Review the parent and its recorded decisions for the remaining work.
investigation_handoff_open: Complete or reassign the investigation finding before closing this follow-up: {finding}
investigation_parent_handoff_open: Complete the handed-off follow-up before deleting this investigation task: {finding}
investigation_review_required: Review the current investigation findings before parking or closing this task.
native_loop_noop: At least six scheduled checks reported no change over at least three hours. Check what the Agent is waiting for and decide whether to keep, change or end the loop.
investigation_findings_open: Give these investigation findings a follow-up, owner decision, or completion evidence first: {findings}
decision_review_changed: This decision has changed or was already handled. Refresh before trying again.
decision_review_fields: This request is missing a valid review time or Undo receipt.
ask_stale: This question was already answered or has changed. Refresh before answering it.
answer_in_session: This is the agent’s own question: answer it in its session.
not_declinable: This can’t be set to Don’t handle.
ask_not_found: This to-do doesn’t have that question. Refresh to see what it asks now.
answer_in_doubt: Your answer may have reached the agent, but Persona couldn’t confirm it. Look at the to-do before answering again.
answer_sent_not_kept: Your answer reached the agent, but Persona couldn’t record it, so the question may still show. You don’t need to answer it again.
draft_changed: This draft has changed or is no longer pending. Refresh before trying again.
draft_dismissed: You chose not to handle this draft. Undo that decision before sending it.
draft_decision_question: Reply drafted from the task’s progress
draft_decision_ignore: Do not handle this draft; do not send a reply. Keep the task and agent open.
draft_decision_undo: Undo the decision not to handle this draft; return it to pending without sending a reply.
plan_waiting: {n} things are waiting for you to start
plan_waiting_single: Something is waiting for you to start
fixed_launcher_unhealthy: Launcher {launcher} is unavailable on fixed computer {machine}: {reason}. This task stays on that computer; retry after its health recovers.
launcher_not_on_machine: Launcher {launcher} isn’t on {machine}, so nothing was started. Launchers that computer has: {launchers}
launcher_swapped: {launcher} isn’t on {machine}, so this runs on {to} with its default model
launcher_desktop_default: {launcher} opens only the New Agent starts you make, so this runs on {to} with its default model
launcher_desktop_default_model: {launcher} opens only the New Agent starts you make, so this runs on {to} with the model you chose, {model}
orca_chat_option_dropped: This opens as {to}, which doesn't offer {option}, so it uses Orca's own setting
launcher_swapped_model: {launcher} isn’t on {machine}, so this runs on {to} with the model you chose, {model}
speed_type: speed must be a string: standard, fast or ultrafast
speed_invalid: invalid Agent speed {speed}: use standard, fast or ultrafast
speed_resume: speed {speed} applies only to a new Agent start, not a resume; leave speed out to use the launcher's own setting
speed_unsupported: launcher {launcher} ({kind}) cannot apply speed {speed} to a new Agent start; leave speed out or choose standard
retried_on_launcher: started again with {to}: {from} couldn’t start on {machine}
retry_launcher_unusable: {launcher} can’t start on {machine} right now: {reason}. Nothing was started. Launchers to try instead: {launchers}
retry_model_without_launcher: A model goes with a launcher: name the launcher too.
retry_launcher_not_started: Nothing was started on {launcher}: this task is already starting again, or it started since. If that start fails too, choose the launcher again.
start_answer_read_only: This device can’t answer a question in a computer’s terminal.
start_answer_node_outdated: Update Persona on {machine} to answer its terminal’s question from here. Nothing was typed.
launcher_kind_missing: {engine} on {machine} has no {launcher} and no other {kind} provider, so nothing was started and no other kind of agent runs in its place. Its providers there: {launchers}
readonly_launcher_unsupported: {launcher} on {machine} starts {agent}, which has no read-only mode, so this read-only task was refused: nothing was started, and no other launcher runs in its place. Plan it writable (readonly false), or read-only on one of that computer’s Claude Code or Codex launchers: {launchers}
start_identity_conflict: The start response did not identify a session on the requested computer.
start_interrupted: The hub restarted while this task’s agent was starting. The earlier request may still finish. Check the computer’s sessions after it reconnects before retrying to avoid starting a second agent.
task_failed_body: {reason}. Open the conversation to tap “Retry”, or assign to another computer
task_failed_body_no_reason: Open the conversation to tap “Retry”, or assign to another computer
not_retryable: Only a task that didn’t start, or was interrupted by a model service error, can be retried
not_in_plan: Can’t find this task’s plan, so it can’t be started again as it was
machine_offline: “{name}” is offline. Try again once it’s connected.
silent_turn: This turn had no output: the agent didn’t reply or call any tools (the model service may have returned nothing)
interrupted: Interrupted by a model service error
stopped_turn: Stopped with its conversation before it had any output
check_agy_unlinked: The agy terminal pane isn't linked to its conversation.
check_side_turn: The last reply didn’t report on this task
route_no_task: This chat doesn’t have that task
route_no_agent: This task has no running agent
route_agents_stopped: Every agent of this task has stopped, so nothing was sent. A message on the task starts a new agent for it.
route_agents_exited: Every agent of this task has stopped already, so there’s nothing to exit. Nothing was sent.
route_starting: A new agent for this task is still starting, so this message wasn't sent. Send it again in a moment.
route_start_unconfirmed: The message may have reached a new agent for this task. Check the task’s agents before sending again. {reason}
route_waited_unconfirmed: The earlier message may have reached a new agent for this task. This request sent no further message. Check the task’s agents before sending again.
route_not_kept: Couldn’t save that this message reopens the task, so it wasn’t sent. Try again.
route_in_doubt: This message may have reached the agent, but Persona couldn’t confirm it. Look at the to-do before sending it again.
route_sent_not_kept: This message reached the agent, but Persona couldn’t add it to the conversation. You don’t need to send it again.
adopt_failed: Could not take it under supervision: {reason}
admission_no_metrics: This computer has not reported resource metrics.
admission_stale: This computer's resource metrics are stale.
admission_no_cores: This computer's core count is not reported.
admission_memory_ambiguous: This computer's memory figures are missing or ambiguous.
admission_memory: Only {available} of free memory left, below its limit of {limit}.
admission_procs: {count} claude processes are already running, at its limit of {limit}.
admission_swap: Swap is {percent}% used ({used} of {total}) and only {available} of memory is free.
admission_direction_full: This direction already has {running} agents running, at its limit of {limit}.
admission_launcher_group_full: Launcher group {group} already has {running} tasks running, at its limit of {limit}.
gateway_quota_wait: The account pool is at its usage limit. An account is expected to recover around {time}.
gateway_quota_unsaved: Persona could not save this task's wait for the account pool. Try starting the task again.
admission_queued: Queued, the hub will retry automatically: {reason}
request_owner_start: This request has prerequisites. Approve the start on its task plan card.
request_edit_piece: Edit the existing to-do's request links before planning its start. The plan cannot change them.
request_new_plan: Make a new plan on this to-do and approve its start on the card. This request does not support continuing or retrying a launch directly.
request_waiting: Start approved. Waiting for acceptance of: {pieces}.
request_unconfirmed: The launch has not been confirmed. If no agent appears, check the computer before starting this work elsewhere. Persona will not repeat this launch automatically.
admission_queue_timeout: Still queued after {limit} of waiting, so the start is given up. Last reason: {reason}
start_link_lost: The connection to “{machine}” dropped, and after it reconnected the task had not started: {reason}
start_machine_busy: “{machine}” stayed connected but did not answer in time (it may be too busy): {reason}
start_link_down: The connection to “{machine}” dropped and did not come back in time: {reason}
codex_effort_terminal: Codex will start in the terminal to use the requested reasoning effort. Approvals and questions will use the terminal screen.
side_handover_archived: Task “{title}” moved to the main conversation because “{origin}” was archived.
side_handover_gone: Task “{title}” moved to the main conversation because “{origin}” is no longer available.
placement_no_match: No online computer currently matches this task's placement constraints and capacity limits.
placement_no_match_detail: No online computer currently matches this task's placement constraints and capacity limits: {details}
placement_hit_leader_work_machine: work-trust computer cannot run a task leader
inbox_link_removed: The Inbox topic changed. Its automatic link was removed; the task can still start.
inbox_candidates: Possible Inbox items: {items}. No automatic link was made; confirm the source before linking.
placement_hit_scratch_unsupported: managed scratch workspace not supported (upgrade Persona Node)
